structuredContent.summary: Review of version-code bump from offset 10 to 20. To achieve ARM801003722 and x64801003728, the `roadium_version_code_offset` in `build/roadium/baseline.json` must be updated to 20. This change is purely metadata-driven and uses the existing `version_code.py` logic to calculate the new codes based on the pinned Chromium version. No architectural or source code changes are required.
architecture_observations: Version code derivation is centralized in `tools/roadium/version_code.py` using `baseline.json` as the source of truth.
The offset is applied to the base Chromium version code generated via `android_chrome_version.GenerateVersionCodes`.
Build orchestration via `prepare-build.sh` and `compile.sh` automatically consumes the offset via the Python script.
Verification via `verify-artifacts.py` strictly enforces that the generated APK/AAB version codes match the expected offset-calculated value.
risks: Incorrect offset value would cause `verify-artifacts.py` to fail during the release gate check.
Manual intervention is required to update the JSON; automation is not present for this specific metadata bump.
tests: Run `python3 tools/roadium/version_code.py <src> build/roadium/baseline.json arm64` to verify output is 801003722.
Run `python3 tools/roadium/version_code.py <src> build/roadium/baseline.json x64` to verify output is 801003728.
Execute `./tools/roadium/prepare-build.sh` and check `gn args` output for `android_override_version_code`.
Run `./tools/roadium/verify-artifacts.py --arch arm64` after build to ensure manifest validation passes.
